We're excited to spotlight how Miki Travel is transforming sales across three divisions with Zoho CRM. ✨

A leading destination management and inbound tour operator, Miki Travel Europe brought its Asia, DMC, and VisitJapan divisions onto a single, unified CRM.

The result is a connected sales operation where teams can see the full picture—from agent relationships and tours to offers and invoices—all in one real-time system, replacing disconnected tools and siloed data.

Our Enterprise Business Solutions (EBS) team took a consulting-led approach to the rollout, working through four phases: requirements, design, build and testing, and training. The solution was also deeply integrated with Miki Travel's existing technology stack.

And the impact goes beyond consolidation. Live dashboards and unified reporting have enabled real-time visibility into performance and KPIs, helping teams spot what matters and make faster, more informed decisions.

We also took a moment to celebrate the success of our partnership with Miki Travel at their London headquarters. 😇

Zoho UK #customersuccess

Tavezio has spent nearly three decades helping camps and similar organizations simplify food and supply procurement, comparing vendor pricing, reconciling invoices, and saving their members time and money.

But running an organization like that also means keeping hundreds of members informed and engaged. That's where Zoho Campaigns comes in. Josh Cohen, President, Tavezio, shares how his team uses it to stay connected with their community:

"I'd say three features of Zoho Campaigns are really key - the Segments feature is great, we have a lot of different user types. We recently started using the Topics feature too, which has been a great resource; it lets our members really understand what the newsletters and emails are about, and control what they want access to. We usually get 70–80% open rates on our emails."

The result: a small team that no longer relies on just one person to manage member communications and a member base that knows when Tavezio reaches out, it's worth acting on.

We’ve got exciting news! 🏆

We're proud to share that Island Practice Management (IPM) has been selected as a finalist for Constellation Research, Inc.'s #SuperNovaAwards2026 in the Digital Safety, Governance, Privacy, and Cybersecurity category.

What are the SuperNova Awards?
Now in its 16th year, the SuperNova Awards are the longest-running recognition of digital transformation in the industry, honoring organizations that use emerging technology to solve real business challenges and deliver measurable impact.

Who is Island Practice Management?
IPM is a Management Services Organization (MSO) that handles the administrative side of mental health practices, including billing, scheduling, and HR, so clinicians can focus on what matters most: patient care.

How did they do it?
Using Zoho One, IPM built a fully connected platform around the patient lifecycle: automating compliance tracking, streamlining intake, centralizing clinical data, and eliminating manual processes that posed risks to patient privacy and experience. The result? Zero compliance lapses, 80%+ revenue growth, and a repeatable model for how healthcare practices can operate securely on owned, connected data.

This is exactly the kind of innovation this category was created to recognize.

Public voting is open August 3 – August 28. Show your support for IPM by casting your vote!

Last Friday, Mumbai came alive for the third edition of the Zoho Enterprise Summit. 🔥

Our Chief Scientist, Sridhar Vembu, opened the evening with firsthand observations from his agentic AI experiments. FYNDNA TechCorp Pvt. Ltd's CEO and Co-Founder, CN Ram followed, talking about why every organization needs to make digital transformation pivots to stay customer-centric and ahead of the curve.

We kept the energy going from there. An industry panel—with Sudhakar Bhagavatula, Chief Digital and Information Officer at Royal Enfield, and Shailesh Davey, moderated by Praval Singh—took on legacy software ecosystems, AI governance, and time-to-value. That flowed into a fireside chat with Durgaprasad Swaminathan, EVP and CIO of Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited, moderated by Aditi Gupta, on navigating his organization's enterprise transformation with Zoho to the broader forces reshaping how enterprises use data, cloud, and AI. 

For the closing note, Anand Nergunam S delivered the Zoho for Enterprise session, on how Zoho works with enterprises to drive digital transformation. The focus: building the durable foundation and the AI capabilities on top of it.

An evening of real questions and perspectives from the people shaping enterprise tech. 🚀

On 15th August, we celebrated India’s 80th Independence Day in New York. 🇮🇳🇺🇸

A proud moment to celebrate how far we've come, the values that unite us, and the spirit that continues to shape our story around the world. ✨
